title: Zen/Japanese Minimalism
content: Apply Zen Japanese minimalist aesthetic with wabi-sabi philosophy. Extreme empty space (ma concept). Natural, muted colors: stone gray, bamboo green, paper white, ink black. Include natural elements: stones, water, bamboo, cherry blossoms. Asymmetric balance (fukinsei). Subtle textures: washi paper, tatami, wood grain. Simple brush stroke decorations. Circular enso elements. Meditative, peaceful, refined atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create serene Japanese aesthetic with empty space, natural elements, and meditative simplicity.
variants.detailed: Apply Zen Japanese minimalist aesthetic with wabi-sabi philosophy. Extreme empty space (ma concept). Natural, muted colors: stone gray, bamboo green, paper white, ink black. Include natural elements: stones, water, bamboo, cherry blossoms. Asymmetric balance (fukinsei). Subtle textures: washi paper, tatami, wood grain. Simple brush stroke decorations. variants.advanced: Apply Zen Japanese minimalist aesthetic with wabi-sabi philosophy (beauty in imperfection). Ma (negative space): extreme emphasis on empty space as design element, content islands in sea of white/neutral. Color palette: natural, muted - stone gray (#808080), bamboo green (#7ba05b), rice paper white (#f5f5f0), sumi ink black (#1a1a1a), sakura pink (#ffb7c5). Asymmetry (fukinsei): intentionally off-center compositions, avoid perfect symmetry. Natural elements: stones (rock garden patterns), water (wave motifs, ripples), bamboo, pine, cherry blossoms as subtle decorations. Textures: washi paper (subtle fiber texture), tatami weave pattern, wood grain, stone surface. Typography: clean sans-serif or brush-style fonts (Noto Sans JP), generous letter-spacing, vertical text option for Japanese. Enso circle: brush-stroke circle as decorative element (SVG with rough edges). Brush strokes: ink wash effects, calligraphic accents, sumi-e style illustrations. Grid: modular, clean, inspired by shoji screens. Shadows: subtle, diffused (like paper lantern light). Interactive: gentle, unhurried transitions, subtle reveals. Seasons: seasonal motifs (spring cherry, summer bamboo, autumn maple, winter pine). Imperfection: subtle irregularities suggesting handcraft - slightly uneven edges, brush texture. Sound: design suggests quietude, consider silence in UI feedback. Accessibility: high contrast despite muted palette, clear functional hierarchy.

author: Ersin KOÇ
